Name: Joja Craftables for CP
Author: cowmastergaarad
Description:
Thank you for your interest in Joja Corp's new line of farming equipment and decorations! Joja Corp has endeavored to improve your farming experience with affordable, long-lasting machines and other products to help you reach your potential and Thrive. 



fr tho I can't believe I couldn't find a mod for this already. I had to make one, it was a crime. I hope you enjoy it.

Honestly, I put way too much work into this. I could've just made everything blue and called it a day, but no, I had to make custom assets with working animations! And I had to make it completely modular like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1877]Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Craftables[/url]!! I suppose if even one person out there enjoys it, it will have been worth it. Please let me know what you think and report any issues!

I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30814]Prismatic Fire - Continued[/url] if you want even more blue in your life.
